subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers require a live Docker repro that separates scheduled heartbeat ticks from untargeted manual `system event --mode now` before authorizing another fix PR for this issue?
rationale: Current source already covers the previously merged stale-config fix, but the reporter has fresh release evidence and the remaining suspected path crosses user-visible routing semantics that automation should not patch blindly.

options.title: Require split live repro first
options.body: Ask for or run a Docker reproduction that distinguishes scheduled heartbeat routing from no-target manual wake routing, then authorize a narrow fix for the confirmed path.

options.title: Queue a narrow source fix now
options.body: Allow a repair attempt against the suspected no-target/default-session path without live Docker proof, accepting higher risk of fixing the wrong entry path.

options.title: Treat as docs/manual-wake ambiguity
options.body: Keep scheduled heartbeat behavior unchanged and clarify `system event --mode now` targeting only if the live repro shows scheduled ticks are already correct.

recommendation.title: Require split live repro first
recommendation.body: Ask for or run a Docker reproduction that distinguishes scheduled heartbeat routing from no-target manual wake routing, then authorize a narrow fix for the confirmed path.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across the gateway cron resolver and the shipped stale-runtime fix that prior cleanup decisions relied on.
